rows: A low, round boar with a huge acorn-cup shoulder plate, tiny rear legs and blunt tusks that tuck neatly under its chin.
Braces with its shoulder plate to intercept hits; not a damage-first bruiser.
A small wax being with drooping sleeves, a worried little face and broad hands cupped around the soul-flame on its head.
Living memorial candle; cupped wax hands
Trades personal safety for stronger ally recovery; soul-flame is visual, not a new element.
A floating ribbon forms a long, hollow body around a crescent face; its two tapered ends curl like expressive ears.
Uses wind ribbons to pressure enemies and briefly interfere with their targeting.
A squat black-stone construct with a huge hinged lower jaw, pillar-like arms and two soft amber eyes beneath a heavy brow.
Pins down a small area with heavy control; slow repositioning is its trade-off.
A barrel-bodied boar with an accordion-fold chest, a flattened shovel snout and copper-colored bristles swept into one crest.
Builds pressure while trading blows, then releases a short cone of heat.
A drowsy tapir with a pillow-fold back, a long drooping snout and small bubble-like pockets visible beneath its soft belly.
Uses dream bubbles for recovery and brief sleep effects; avoid permanent control loops.
A long, low marten with oversized silent paws, a brush-tip tail and a dark face broken by two narrow white cheek marks.
Uses water-darkened cover for hit-and-run attacks; fragile when caught.
A stubby imp with tiny blunt horns, warm ember eyes and an enormous spade-shaped tail that wraps around it like a blanket.
A common early-game fiend; its tail alternates between a close-range strike and a small guard.
A broad little fiend with oversized charcoal fists, short curled horns and a tiny round face tucked between its shoulders.
Wins prolonged close-range trades; deliberately lacks assassin mobility.
A short-legged yak with a sweeping wool skirt, wide curled horns and a gentle face almost lost beneath its thick fringe.
Shelters nearby allies and offers modest sustain; low personal damage.
A low, long-bodied cat with one oversized translucent foreclaw, a narrow wedge-shaped head and a thick balancing tail.
Commits to one powerful claw strike; the recovery window should remain punishable.
A broad horned skull floats above a ring of pale ribs; little mitten-shaped bones hover beside its softly glowing eyes.
Floating horned skull; orbiting rib shield
Rotates a rib barrier toward incoming threats; bone theme retains the Wind element.
A slender deer carries broad, shallow antlers like leafy shelves, with small buds nestled close to its long, gentle face.
Creates safe patches of growth; healing is tied to positioning rather than constant output.
A squashy dream creature has four pillow-like corners, a crescent mouth and a long folded tip that droops over one eye.
A dream being, not an undead soul; specializes in recovery and removing debuffs.
A chunky tuber creature has root-mitten forearms, a tiny leafy crown and an earthy face set low in its broad belly.
Roots itself for stronger defense; must unroot before moving.
A squat heap of rounded bones forms one huge arm and a tiny grinning skull, with a rib cage that sits slightly off-center.
Reassembles between heavy exchanges; keep this visually distinct from the smaller Rattlebit.
A broad, pebble-bodied puppy has oversized paddle paws, a tiny stone tail and a muzzle that always looks slightly surprised.
Travels in skipping hops and overshoots when excited; modest durability, not a dedicated tank.
A low-slung fiend has a huge soot-dark mane, short ivory horns and tiny warm eyes above a broad, toothy grin.
A late-game fiend with a compact, companionable face; damage depends on staying aggressive.
A round ceramic cistern walks on four squat feet, with gutter-shaped arms and a small face beneath its heavy lid.
Stores incoming water-themed energy for barriers and limited ally recovery.
A narrow silver fish has four long, scythe-shaped fins and a ribbon tail; a thin loop of water holds it above the ground.
Uses its water loop for sharp dashes; keep the fin silhouette readable without effects.
A split seedpod holds a tiny bright face above two long spring-root legs, with a pair of small leaves folded like ears.
Springs in and out of range; a plant attacker rather than another passive healer.
A tiny ivory skeleton has an oversized skull, mitten-like bone hands and short limbs that fold neatly into its rib cage.
Tiny skeleton; oversized skull and hands
Common at level 5 in the retained schedule, making the undead fantasy available early.
A compact bear cub has huge forepaws, a small stern face and thick shoulder fur that curls into two wind-swept spirals.
Builds momentum through consecutive melee exchanges; defense is secondary to pressure.
A small rag doll has one enormous stitched hand, a crooked button eye and a soft crown of blunt, mismatched pins.
Haunted rag doll; oversized stitched hand
Mixes short-range hits with brief weakening effects; soft materials keep it endearing.
A heavy seedpod jaw sits on four buttress-root legs, with a small pair of eyes hidden beneath an overhanging thorny brow.
A plant predator that can hold space after lunging; roots should limit its chase potential.
A diamond-shaped paper being stretches over curved amber ribs, with a tiny central face and two long, split ribbon tails.
Living kite; amber ribs; paper sails
Attacks along its glide path; its folded resting pose should remain recognizable.
A heavy ground bird has a blunt hooked beak and broad, stone-plated wing knuckles that nearly touch its short feet.
Folds its wings into a guard; intentionally not another airborne Wind attacker.
A small brass gong hangs inside its own round frame, with crescent feet, mitten-like beaters and a sleepy embossed face.
Takes hits to build a protective pulse; sound is a behavior, not a separate damage element.
A long-necked bird has sweeping wings made from a few large glass plates, their old cracks traced by fine luminous seams.
Beauty comes from repaired wing plates rather than extra ornaments; allow visible attack windup.
A narrow heron hides its body behind one long, draped wing, leaving a needle beak and two delicate black legs exposed.
Heron; one draped wing; needle beak
Hides its attack tell behind a wing, then commits to a straight shot.
A round little bird has a short beak, two honey-colored throat sacs and a broad feather bib that almost covers its feet.
Round nectar bird; paired throat sacs
Inflating throat sacs provide a clear cue for its supportive song.
A round owl has a smooth, sliding feather mask, tiny visible feet and two large eyes that peer out from beneath its rim.
Opens and closes its mask to signal attack and disruption states.
A slender insect has a single crescent gliding membrane, hooked feet and a long tail that splits into two narrow blades.
Prefers clean passes rather than sustained trading; distinctive crescent silhouette.
A small wind being folds into two sharp chevrons around a dark eye, with one soft tuft trailing from its pointed head.
A non-animal Wind attacker; keep a solid readable body instead of relying on particles.
A small translucent spirit hugs a smooth pebble; a ring of smaller stones floats inside its rounded belly beneath shy eyes.
Uses its carried stone as a bond focus; comforting afterlife tone rather than horror.
A broad, flightless bird balances a tiny stern head over enormous bent legs, with short winglets and a stiff paddle tail.
Wind-assisted jumps replace flight; heavy landings create brief openings for allies.
A tall mushroom floats beneath a broad, ribbed cap, its long root-tendrils twisting together into a narrow hanging funnel.
A plant-based ranged controller; pressure comes from positioning enemies, not healing.
A thick metal ring surrounds a small bright eye, with two heavy stone arms and three sail-like fins along its rim.
Living gyroscope; stone arms; sail fins
Winds up before a circular melee sequence; stopping its spin should expose it.
A great dark corvid has three paired layers of blade-shaped wings, a compact crowned head and a long forked tail.
Great corvid; three paired wing layers
Retained boss-preview slot; design a legible three-stage wing attack rather than constant effects.
A slender imp folds huge velvet ear-wings around its body, leaving a tiny grin, hooked thumbs and two little feet visible.
Unfurls its ear-wings to strike; cute face and small feet soften the sneaky silhouette.
A squat toad has a wide, pale throat bowl, tiny webbed hands and a low collar of rounded leaves around its shoulders.
Toad; wide throat bowl; small leaf collar
Pools restorative water in its throat bowl; strongest when allies stay close.
A puffed-up coal imp has huge round cheeks, two short horn-shaped vents and little hands planted proudly on its hips.
Releases built-up heat in short bursts; exaggerated cheeks telegraph its next shot.
A broad crucible body rests on two squat legs, with huge ceramic forearms and a small molten face deep inside its rim.
Stores heat while guarding and spends it on close-range disruption.
A tiny glass-bodied frog has a broad clear belly dotted with star-like lights and four oversized crescent-shaped feet.
Glass frog; broad clear belly; crescent feet
Its glass belly fills before a burst; the small silhouette stays cute at higher levels.
A long, soft-bodied dragon has enormous ribbon gills, stubby hind feet and a translucent belly shaded like the dawn sky.
An approachable late-game dragon; balances graceful close-range strikes with limited ally recovery.
Three coal-headed ants fit beneath overlapping shell plates, forming one stocky six-legged creature with three tiny faces.
One roster entry made of three bodies; needs a shared rig/formation plan before production.
A broad beetle has four rounded, leaf-shaped shell plates, short gripping legs and a small face beneath a deep front rim.
Beetle; four folding leaf-like shell plates
Shell plates close to guard; movement and damage drop while fully sealed.
A narrow hopper balances on two long, branching hind legs, with a small crested head and a smooth, shell-white abdomen.
Uses elevated firing angles; coral-like anatomy does not require an ocean-only encounter.
A tiny soot-dark soul has two warm pinprick eyes and soft curled arms that frame a small floating flame above its head.
A late-game cute option; the flame should read as a soul-light rather than a firefly body.
A low, angular mantis folds its broad forearms into a closed leaf bud over its face, leaving thin eyes visible beneath.
Opens its leaf-bud guard immediately before striking; avoid overlap with Mirrormantis's false body.
A fuzzy moth wears a deep hood-like collar, with broad split wings and two soft lantern-shaped pockets near its shoulders.
Fuzzy moth; hood collar; broad split wings
Gentle wing beats carry support effects; preserve a compact body beneath the large wings.
A thin mantis holds two broad mirror forearms together as a false torso, while its real head peeks around one bright edge.
Presents a false centerline before sidestepping to strike; tests must verify readability.
A pointed crystal body holds a tiny dark eye, with three large triangular fins hovering close around its narrow middle.
Floating crystal lance; three orbiting fins
Fires along the lance axis; only three large fins, not a cloud of decorative fragments.
A squat amber tower has enormous block-like arms, a recessed stern face and a small leafy twig suspended inside its chest.
Squat amber tower; oversized block arms
Hardens into a stronger guard; the trapped twig links its crafted body to the living world.
A broad-petaled flower floats above a tiny seed face, with long saffron-colored roots curled into two delicate loops.
Flower body; broad petals; thread-like roots
Supportive root threads are kept few and thick enough to read at game-camera scale.
A plump charcoal grub has a huge pale face, six tiny mitten feet and two cheek vents beneath a short bristly crest.
Plump grub; soot vents; mitten feet
A cute late-game brawler; cheek vents release short heat puffs between body checks.
A low, polished scarab carries a broad circular back framed by two crescent wing cases, with a small calm face underneath.
Scarab; circular back; crescent wing cases
A majestic mid-game insect; opens its shell to project protection but exposes its body.
A heavy beetle has a drum-shaped abdomen, thick blocky legs and two short forked antennae over a wide, stubborn face.
Heavy beetle; drum abdomen; fork antennae
Wind-driven drum impacts explain its element without adding an Electricity type.
A poised little fiend has long smooth horns and broad wings folded like a mantle, with a small bright face and tiny toes.
A late-game majestic fiend, not a cruel villain; its mantle carries ally protection.
A seedpod head with three round openings sits on an accordion stem, above root feet and two tiny leaf-shaped hands.
Air through its seedpod openings powers short buffs; keep timing cues simple.
A great pale weaver has long arching legs, a small veiled face and a crescent frame around its silk-filled abdomen.
Grand silk weaver; crescent abdominal frame
Retained boss-preview slot; combines web zoning with ranged pressure, not a default healer.
A slender spider carries one large pearl-like abdomen, with two raised front legs and six delicate, sharply bent walking legs.
Spider; pearl abdomen; poised front legs
Threads set up precise water-themed shots; avoid duplicating the Moonweaver boss's broad control.
A tiny hooded skeleton has four long, spring-bent limbs, a rounded skull and two little tooth tips beneath its bright eyes.
Small skeleton; four spring limbs; soft hood
Slender limbs enable low, quiet movement; use clean rounded bones rather than exposed anatomy.
A soil-colored imp has curling root-like horns, huge open palms and a leaf-shaped tail, with an irrepressible crooked grin.
Soil-colored imp; root horns; broad palms
An early-region Earth fiend that trips enemies and offers small ally boosts.
A soft, box-shaped fish has two large side air sacs, a tiny smiling face and a translucent sail tail larger than its body.
Floating boxfish; paired air sacs; sail tail
Helps allies reposition; should read as a buoyant organism, not a fish glued to a cloud.
A round urchin has broad hexagonal spines that fit into a faceted shell, with tiny pink tube feet and two bead-like eyes.
Plates close into a shell; limited reach keeps its defensive specialty clear.
A clear ring of water surrounds a small suspended bead-face, with two dangling droplet feet and a folded leaf collar.
Living water ring; suspended bead face
A non-animal early Water support; its hollow center is the key visual signature.
A soft jelly has a cap tilted far to one side, a tiny sleepy face and three unequal ribbon-like arms beneath its clear rim.
Tilted jelly cap; tiny body; unequal ribbons
Drifting ribbons slow targets while the body adds light pressure; not a primary damage carry.
A clear-bodied shrimp has one enormous prismatic claw, a narrow pointed face and a thick tail folded tightly beneath it.
One large claw makes the attack source clear; strong burst is balanced by a visible reload pose.
A folded shroud forms a wide kite-shaped body around a tiny rounded skull face, with two little feet beneath its pointed hem.
Folded shroud; tiny skull face; kite silhouette
A light, sneaky afterlife being; use soft folds rather than torn or decayed cloth.
A broad manta has layered, petal-like fins, a short curling tail and a serene face set beneath the front edge of its body.
Fins unfurl into a clear support area; visual elegance matters more than extra ornament.
A broad mist body has two drooping arm-lobes, small dark eyes and a clean oval window passing straight through its torso.
Broad vapor body; clear torso window
A vapor-bodied tank/support that screens allies; durability comes from mitigation rather than bulk.
A low stack of shale forms a deep-set face between two enormous arch-shaped arms, with four small stones for feet.
Holds nearby enemies away from allies; little reach and low speed constrain its control.
A small otter has broad paddle-like mittens, a thick flat tail and a pale muzzle framed by two swept-back cheek tufts.
Otter; paddle mittens; broad steering tail
A common early Water companion; mixes close-range strikes with small repositioning assists.
An empty flowing veil frames two gentle lights, held open by oversized rounded bone hands above a small scalloped hem.
Wraps its veil around allies; a majestic undead companion without a horror silhouette.
A low black lizard has a broad forked crest around its eyes, a tightly curled tail and pale plates beneath its heavy jaw.
Low lizard; forked facial crest; curled tail
Uses ash-laced ranged pressure; its grounded silhouette contrasts with flying Fire attackers.
A squat succulent stands on three root feet, with thick basalt-colored leaves cupping a tiny bright face at its center.
A late-game cute tank; regeneration should reward holding ground rather than endless retreat.
A regal, low-bodied salamander has a crown-shaped crest and a broad pleated tail that opens into a glowing fan.
Retained boss-preview slot; grandeur comes from its fan silhouette, not humanoid armor.
A flat skink has a long balancing tail, small alert eyes and four broad blade-shaped feet splayed close to the ground.
Flat skink; broad paired skate feet
Slides across ash between attacks; its feet should explain the movement.
A ring of rounded ribs forms a wheel around a small grinning skull, with two oversized bone hands hanging at its sides.
A non-animal skeleton silhouette; unfolds its hands to brake and strike.
A tightly coiled fern has hooked root feet, two pale eyes beneath its fronds and a long stem edged with folding leaf blades.
Uncoils for a short attack window; fully plant-based rather than a snake wearing leaves.
A broad turtle has one oversized shell plate that tilts upright, thick forelegs and a small, stern face under a deep brow.
Raises a sheltering wall for allies; strong from one direction, vulnerable when flanked.
A thick serpent wears loose black slag rings around a narrow bright body, with a blunt wedge-shaped head and small hot eyes.
Thick serpent; loose slag armor rings
Sheds its bulky rings for a fast attack phase, trading defense for pressure.
A round axolotl has tiny mitten feet, a wide gentle mouth and layered feathery gills that curl upward like soft steam plumes.
A cute late-game Water support; gills provide a readable cue for cleansing pulses.
A tall spiral of clear water sits within a floating crown of broad shell plates, with two gentle lights deep in its center.
Living water spiral; floating shell crown
Retained boss-preview slot; a non-animal boss built around water barriers and protective zones.
A huge hollow trunk walks on branching root hands, with an arch-shaped torso and a broad face beneath hanging moss brows.
Hollow treant; root hands; arch-like torso
Retained boss-preview slot; its hollow trunk should be readable before any foliage detail.
A tall orchid stands on four pointed roots, its broad petals folding into a beak-like jaw around a small glowing seed.
Predatory orchid; four roots; hinged petal jaw
A predatory flower, not a healer; opens fully before its high-commitment bite.
A small mushroom body peers up at its own wide hovering cap, with tiny root hands reaching toward the cap's pale underside.
Adjusts its cap to direct supportive spores; the detached cap is the defining feature.
A small ivory face floats within a wide rosette of soft petals, with two little hands dangling beneath its flower-cloak.
Connects death imagery to remembrance and comfort; not an evil or decaying plant.
A squat moss being has a hollow, bowl-shaped head, root mittens and small seedlings sprouting from patched areas of its body.
Moss body; bowl-shaped head; root mittens
A durable little plant; sacrifices some regrowth to shelter nearby allies.
A narrow seed body hangs beneath four large pinwheel petals, with long curved roots trailing behind a tiny pointed face.
A flower attacker that glides on its own petals; not another floating healer.
A monumental amber frame surrounds a small bright core, with broad separated arms and a recessed, surprisingly gentle face.
Retained boss-preview slot; keep the core and two arms as the main readable masses.
A clear, wobbly slime holds a huge closed flower bud inside its body, with stubby feet and a tiny face below the bud.
Clear slime; huge suspended flower bud
A common early amorphous companion; absorbs pressure before releasing a modest recovery bloom.
A small faceless bell floats above a shadow with an expressive round face and soft ears; its body has two tiny side handles.
Faceless floating bell; expressive living shadow
Requires readable ground shadows; prototype this before committing to the concept.
A flat inkblot has a crooked white grin, two long brush-tip arms and a pointed head that folds over like wet paper.
A living ink being, not an infernal imp; smudges mark or weaken targets.
A squat skeletal guardian holds a broad jawbone shield, with thick knucklebone limbs and two shy lights deep in its skull.
Skeletal guardian; jaw shield; knucklebone limbs
Defensive counterpart to Rattlebit; these are separate concepts, not a confirmed evolution line.
A small rounded coffin has a shy face in its dark opening, soft spectral arms at its sides and two stubby wooden feet.
Small upright coffin; soft spectral arms
Closes its lid to guard and opens to engage; charming rather than realistically funerary.
A long armored crawler has broad overlapping kiln-like plates, many short gripping feet and a heavy blunt head with tiny eyes.
Maintains pressure through steady advances; avoid copying Moltencoil's armor-shedding mechanic.
Three tiny round spirits carry one oversized smiling mask, with their little hands and dangling feet visible around its edge.
Three tiny spirits; one shared ceremonial mask
One collectible with three carriers; requires a shared movement rig and clear targeting rules.
A small snail has a huge backward-wound spiral shell, a broad flat foot and short eye stalks above a determined little mouth.
Winds its shell like a spring for a fast charge; poor braking is its defining weakness.
